mutants.description: The envelope is closed only when the elapsed count equals the ceiling, so the case of a ceiling that has dropped below the elapsed count leaves pulse_allowed open
mutants.reason: When max_on_counts falls below run_counter during a pulse (soft_start reloads MIN_ON_CNT on restart, or clamps to max_on_limit), the counter correctly stops but pulse_allowed stays 1, so pwm_out keeps following pwm_sync for the rest of the pulse instead of going low one clock later.

mutants.description: The output takes 'pulse in progress' from run_counter being non-zero instead of from pwm_sync, so it follows the counter's one-clock-late view of the pulse
mutants.reason: Every untruncated pulse at pwm_out starts and ends one clock later than with pwm_sync gating. A truncated pulse comes out one clock shorter. With a ceiling of 0 the counter never leaves zero, so pwm_out never goes high.
